provenance: The compose document is FerroEHR's own published quickstart, fetched from its repository at run time, so the reproduction drives whatever that release train currently pins. The Basic-auth pair is the quickstart's declared development user, which this repository's browser journeys drive first-hand. The topology declares one clinical principal and the unauthenticated one, so every case addressing an admin, read-only or SMART principal is recorded not-applicable at selection time rather than driven under the wrong identity.
